# gns3_node (List Resource)

Lists the nodes of one GNS3 project (`GET /v2/projects/{project_id}/nodes`). The project must be open: GNS3 does not report the nodes of a closed project. With resources included, `properties` and `startup_config` are null, as after `terraform import`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List resources need Terraform 1.14 or later. Put this file beside the root
# module's .tf files and run: terraform query
list "gns3_node" "lab" {
  provider = gns3

  config {
    project_id = "2d37e1d1-0bbd-4525-8777-529b1bba7f85"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project whose nodes are listed.
